features.description: Operator creates new 'Jarvis' billing account and links to jarvis-a6ee1
steps: Operator: console.cloud.google.com/billing/create → name 'Jarvis', add payment method
Operator: report account ID (format XXXXXX-XXXXXX-XXXXXX)
Claude: gcloud beta billing projects link jarvis-a6ee1 --billing-account=<ID>
Verify: gcloud beta billing projects describe jarvis-a6ee1 → billingEnabled: true
features.acceptance: gcloud beta billing projects describe jarvis-a6ee1 returns billingEnabled: true with the new account name

features.description: Enable required GCP APIs on jarvis-a6ee1
steps: gcloud services enable firestore.googleapis.com firebasestorage.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com iamcredentials.googleapis.com --project=jarvis-a6ee1
Verify each service appears in: gcloud services list --enabled --project=jarvis-a6ee1

features.description: Create default Cloud Storage bucket for jarvis-a6ee1
steps: gcloud storage buckets create gs://jarvis-a6ee1.appspot.com --project=jarvis-a6ee1 --location=us-central1 --uniform-bucket-level-access
Or: firebase use orchestrator && firebase deploy --only storage (creates default if missing)
features.acceptance: gcloud storage buckets list --project=jarvis-a6ee1 shows one bucket

features.description: Create orchestrator service account with required IAM roles
steps: gcloud iam service-accounts create orchestrator --display-name='Jarvis Orchestrator' --project=jarvis-a6ee1
Grant roles: roles/storage.admin, roles/datastore.user, roles/logging.logWriter, roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
Last role enables signed URL minting via IAM credentials API
features.acceptance: gcloud projects get-iam-policy jarvis-a6ee1 shows orchestrator@jarvis-a6ee1.iam.gserviceaccount.com with all 4 roles

features.description: Generate service account JSON key, store in .secrets/, verify gitignored
steps: gcloud iam service-accounts keys create .secrets/jarvis-a6ee1-orchestrator.json --iam-account=orchestrator@jarvis-a6ee1.iam.gserviceaccount.com
git check-ignore .secrets/jarvis-a6ee1-orchestrator.json (must succeed)
Operator action: mirror to 1Password vault 'Jarvis' as 'jarvis-a6ee1 orchestrator key'
features.acceptance: Key file exists at expected path, git check-ignore returns 0, operator confirms 1Password entry created

steps: firebase deploy --only storage --project=orchestrator
Confirm rules deployed: firebase deploy output shows 'Deploy complete'
features.acceptance: firebase storage:rules:get --project=orchestrator returns deployed rule content matching repo storage.rules

steps: firebase_client.py wraps firebase-admin SDK, reads creds from .secrets/, exposes upload(path, bytes) → signed_url(ttl)
smoke_test_storage.py: upload fixture to evidence/test-{timestamp}.json, request 1h signed URL, GET it, assert 200
Capture output to evidence/smoke-test-{timestamp}.log
features.acceptance: smoke test exits 0 with HTTP 200 from signed URL fetch; log artifact in evidence/

features.description: Patch refresh-costs.sh — add 'Jarvis' bucket and jarvis-a6ee1 project mapping
steps: Add jarvis-a6ee1 to project→app mapping under app='Jarvis'
Add 'Jarvis' to totals object
Add UNION ALL for new billing-export table (commented placeholder; activates when operator confirms BigQuery export configured)
Run refresh-costs.sh: should succeed, show Jarvis: 0 (no export yet) or actual value if 24h+ have passed
features.acceptance: refresh-costs.sh exits 0, costs.json contains 'Jarvis' key in totals (value may be 0)

features.description: F020 — quota_check.py writes ~/.jarvis/quota_state.json with per-model weekly token consumption
steps: Read Claude usage from ~/.claude/projects/*/sessions/*.jsonl (sum input+output tokens)
Read Codex usage from ~/.codex (CLI quota subcommand or local tally)
Read Gemini usage from gemini CLI state
Read Grok usage from local API call counter (file-based since no quota API)
Read Ollama from `ollama ps` (loaded models)
Compute week-to-date percent of weekly cap, write JSON
Cap thresholds: claude=Max plan estimate, codex=300/wk, gemini=AI Studio quota, grok=50/wk, ollama=unmetered
features.acceptance: python3 scripts/quota_check.py exits 0, ~/.jarvis/quota_state.json contains non-empty 'models' map with at least claude+ollama entries

features.description: Update parent plan features.json (rename jarvis-main → jarvis-a6ee1) + log decision D036
steps: Edit ../2026-04-19-001/features.json F002: replace 'jarvis-main' with 'jarvis-a6ee1' in description and steps
Append D036 to ../2026-04-19-001/decisions.jsonl: project ID rename, why (Firebase auto-suffix)
Re-run validate_plan.py against parent plan to confirm still valid
features.acceptance: Parent features.json F002 references jarvis-a6ee1, decisions.jsonl has D036, validator passes

features.description: Flip parent F002 + F020 to passes:true with evidence_refs once SF007 + SF009 green
steps: After SF007 green: edit parent F002 passes=true, evidence_refs=[smoke-test log]
After SF009 green: edit parent F020 passes=true, evidence_refs=[quota_state.json snapshot]
Append decisions.jsonl entry for each flip
features.acceptance: Parent features.json shows F002.passes=true and F020.passes=true with evidence_refs populated
